messages:
noah: Quick thread to finalize customer comms follow-ups for the inference service degradation. Need clear owners for: 72h customer note, short public status update, RCA redaction policy, and verification after fix.
alisa: I can draft the 72h note. Will include impact summary + what customers should expect next.
mike: I'll do the public status blurb and confirm exact timestamps with infra.
tara: I'll take RCA redaction rules and coordinate legal review. Legal asks to avoid raw logs and token names.
legal-bot: Note: legal review SLA is ~24h once draft submitted. Use legal@redwood and cc privacy when customer data is involved.
noah: Proposed deadlines: public blurb (mike) due +18h, 72h note (alisa) due +48h, redaction draft (tara) due +36h + legal review within 24h of that. Verification plan (mike + infra) due +7d.
mike: Draft status copy suggestion:
```
We experienced a temporary degradation of inference performance impacting a subset of requests between 05:13-05:48 UTC. The incident was mitigated and normal service has resumed. We are investigating the root cause and will share updates.
```
alisa: Suggest replace "degradation" with "performance regression" in customer-facing text? Slightly more neutral.
tara: For the redaction checklist (initial):
- strip IPs and exact hostnames
- mask customer IDs (show counts or ranges)
- no verbatim stack traces or error tokens
- avoid vendor/internal service names in public copy unless vendor consent obtained
If a customer requests full RCA, route through support + legal and consider an NDA or secure share link.
noah: Also flag recurring-pattern: platform team reported similar scaling regressions 3 times in last 90 days. Let's tag this incident as "recurring-pattern" and prepare a short internal summary for platform. That summary should not be in the public note unless legal signs off.
mike: Agreed. I'll add the recurring-pattern tag and ping platform-eng.
noah: Action items I'm adding to tracker now:
- ACTION-4120: Public status blurb (mike) - due +18h
- ACTION-4121: 72h customer note draft (alisa) - due +48h
- ACTION-4122: RCA redaction checklist (tara) - due +36h
- ACTION-4123: Legal review (legal) - due within 24h of ACTION-4122
- ACTION-4124: Verification plan & 7d metrics check (mike + infra) - due +7d
- ACTION-4125: Recurring-pattern memo (noah) - due +3d
tara: Legal: one constraint — if any customer data is in scope, privacy must be looped and the disclosure path must be pre-approved.
legal-bot: A reminder: postmortem doc created at https://redwood/pms/1767009876 (edit)
mike: I'll draft status copy and ping infra for exact timestamps.
alisa: I'll start the 72h note and include a short FAQ for customers about next steps.
noah: Thanks all. Please update the tracker when you start work. I'll compile the finished drafts into the postmortem and assign final reviewers. :thumbsup:
